title: What were the actual words?
instructions: Here you go the other way: what did the people **really** say? Write the **direct speech** (the imperative). You don't need quotation marks.

items.direct: Diego told Mila not to worry.
Sofia told Mila to stay away from the old bridge.
answer: Stay away from the old bridge( Mila)!
Mila stay away from the old bridge!

items.direct: Mrs Moreno asked Mila to set the table.
Coach Brooks told the players not to give up.
items.hint: not to give up → **Don't give up**

items.direct: Ms Kim told the class to open their books at page 20.
Mr Okafor told Mila to come back the next day.
